option_relations.rationale: The option 'Multidrug-resistant Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Multidrug-resistant Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection'.

Ganciclovir-resistant cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection is a type of drug-resistant CMV infection, and multidrug-resistant CMV infection (the leaf) implies resistance to ganciclovir and other drugs, making the option a supertype.
Pneumocystis pneumonia (PCP) is a distinct infection caused by Pneumocystis jirovecii, unrelated to Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection.

Cytomegalovirus (CMV) disease (pneumonitis/disseminated) is a broader category of CMV infection, and multidrug-resistant CMV infection (the leaf) is a specific type of CMV infection with drug resistance.
